name: Belmond Cap Juluca
insider_take: This legendary resort sits on one of the Caribbean's most photographed beaches, where powder-white sand meets turquoise waters in absolute perfection.
whats_special: Belmond Cap Juluca occupies a mile-long stretch of Maundays Bay, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches. The resort's distinctive Moorish architecture with white-washed villas and blue domes creates an almost otherworldly aesthetic against Anguilla's natural beauty. As part of the exclusive Belmond collection, it offers unparalleled luxury on an island known for having no casinos, traffic lights, or chain restaurants.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the clifftop spa during sunset hours - the panoramic ocean views combined with Anguilla's famous golden hour light create an unforgettable wellness experience.
dont_miss: The resort's beachfront restaurant Pimms serves some of the Caribbean's finest cuisine with tables literally on the sand. Take advantage of Anguilla's proximity to St. Martin - it's just a 20-minute ferry ride to explore duty-free shopping and French culture, making this one of the most accessible luxury island getaways in the region.
pros: Pristine white sand beach on Maundays Bay
World-class dining with multiple restaurant options
